name: @legion/envoy-client
//: test: each command's --timeout is at least twice the slowest row or hook it runs without a guard of its own, as #4437 read them under 8 busy loops on 2 CPUs (builds Jobs, 2026-11-19 to 2026-11-21), and longer than every bound of a wait in those rows, so a wait names a hang before the guard ends its row.

The first, 45000: the slowest row, nats-credential-deadlines.test.ts's switch whose first trade answers 503 and waits for ready, 13,404.06 ms (three runs in builds Job g4b-ec-first, legion-load-run-hbzpt, 2026-11-21, at #4437's round-4 tree 24b2e96b28), and the slowest hook, the temporary-directory afterEach dispatch-review.test.ts registers, 84.15 ms; nats-handshake.test.ts's slowest row, a server that never answers, which waits out its dial's whole 10 s bound on the process's clock, at most 10,104.52 ms (builds Jobs nt-t1-8 and nt-c1-8, 2026-11-20), and nats-dial-retry.test.ts's, the last dial's own error, at most 623.22 ms. Twice the slowest is 26,808.12 ms; the guard is 45000 rather than 30000 because `turnsUntil` (@legion/test-fixtures/fake-clock) bounds each of its waits at 30 s of real time by default, and the rows that wait through it with no bound of their own (nats-credential-deadlines.test.ts, nats-credential-keeper.test.ts, dispatch-credential-deadline.test.ts, nats-dial-retry.test.ts, envoy-config.test.ts, membership-held.test.ts) must name a hang before the guard ends them.

The second, 120000: the files whose rows, once they set no guard of their own, take more than half the first's. dispatch-write-outcomes.test.ts, whose every sequence of events took 16,382.88 ms under that load (builds Job d8-ec-first-8); broker-credential-signins.test.ts, whose closed client's slot took 16,094.57 ms (d8-ec-moved-8), and whose setDefaultTimeout(HANG_GUARD_MS) gives its rows the same 120000; askgate-record.test.ts's row of four writers, 25.67 s at most in a whole-suite run under 16 busy loops (8 x nproc); and dispatch-askgate.test.ts's row of twelve child process trees, 58.37 s at most in a whole-suite run under 16 busy loops, which 120000 holds 2.06 times.

These keep a guard of their own. The rows and hooks of the files the envoy-session-stall job runs with a bare `bun test <file>`, whose own guard is the only one that run has: nats-stall.test.ts, nats-credential.test.ts's hub behind the auth service (its beforeAll's Go build of natsd and calloutd, 300000, and its rows), test/session-stall.ts, design-gate-advice, moved-approval-advice and comment-mention.live.test.ts, and dispatch-keyed-resend-live.test.ts (its beforeAll 600000, its afterAll 60000, its rows 120000), ci-results.live.test.ts (its beforeAll 600000, its afterAll hooks 60000, its rows 120000 and 180000) and ci-result-refusal-log.live.test.ts (its beforeAll 600000, its afterAll 60000, its row 180000). nats-credential-deadlines.test.ts's three ready rows (READY_ROW_MS, 65000), each two `turnsUntil` waits of READY_WAIT_MS, 30 s, one after the other, longer together than the first command's guard. The rows of the files whose setDefaultTimeout(HANG_GUARD_MS) sets Bun's kill at 120000 for a bare `bun test <file>`: broker-credential, broker-credential-signins, device-login, dispatch-config, envoy-config, envoy-settings, membership-held, nats-auth, nats-credential, process-group, secret-file, session-settings and session-timing.test.ts, with nats-auth.test.ts's Docker hooks (NATS_START_HOOK_MS, NATS_STOP_HOOK_MS) and envoy-config.test.ts's rows as they were before #4437. In such a run that kill alone holds: a shared wait reads the command line's guard, Bun's 5000 ms there, so broker-credential-signins.test.ts's span(16_000) is refused at once. And every other row that keeps the guard it had before #4437 and holds no shared wait, such as dispatch-cli.test.ts's rows that print another call's stored answer as no answer of their own (30000).
